facts.summary: Positive early data, durable complete remissions, dose selected · Phase 1 · INB-100 in leukemia · not yet approved
facts.indication: leukemia (AML, ALL) undergoing hematopoietic stem cell transplantation

evidence.summary: 100% of evaluable patients (n=7) treated with INB-100 remained alive, progression-free, and in durable complete remission (CR) as of April 21, 2023
evidence.safety: The study’s updated safety data reported low-grade (1-2) graft versus host disease (GvHD) in all patients treated, which was steroid-responsive, and had a more rapid onset at higher dose levels. No dose limiting toxicities (DLTs) have been observed.
evidence.program_discontinued: The trial is being expanded at this dose level, and additional patients are actively being enrolled and treated in the study
